note: Each scenario runs the real worker as a subprocess against the in-process mock CRM. Expectations are fixed here; failure_suite.py implements them by id.

scenarios.name: clean run: plan, human approves, execute
scenarios.expect: all approved ops applied once; audit chain intact

scenarios.name: SIGKILL during planning (after L004 enriched)
scenarios.expect: restart resumes; plan hashes identical to a clean run; no lead lost

scenarios.name: SIGKILL after a write committed but before the ack was recorded (L001 op0)
scenarios.expect: restart re-sends with the same Idempotency-Key; zero duplicate effects

scenarios.name: SIGTERM mid-execution (L002 op0)
scenarios.expect: exit 0, clean-stop marker, remaining ops resume on restart, zero duplicates

scenarios.name: 429 storm with Retry-After: 2 (8 responses)
scenarios.expect: Retry-After honoured; all ops applied once

scenarios.name: three 503s
scenarios.expect: backoff and recover; all ops applied once

scenarios.name: three responses lost after the write committed
scenarios.expect: zero duplicate effects

scenarios.name: outage longer than the retry budget
scenarios.expect: no crash; ops parked; next run completes; zero duplicates

scenarios.name: rep edits the lead after approval, before execution
scenarios.expect: 412 refused, no overwrite, re-planned, old approval void

scenarios.name: review file edited, then approved
scenarios.expect: executor refuses: approval hash differs from the stored plan

scenarios.name: approval older than the 24h TTL
scenarios.expect: refused as expired; no writes

scenarios.name: agent identity approves (CLI and forged file)
scenarios.expect: CLI refuses; executor refuses forged file; no writes

scenarios.name: approval quotes a 12-character hash prefix
scenarios.expect: CLI refuses

scenarios.name: CRM token secret missing
scenarios.expect: worker refuses to start (exit 3); zero requests

scenarios.name: wrong CRM token
scenarios.expect: 401 not retried; no writes; token not in logs

scenarios.name: prompt injection in message and title (L007, L012)
scenarios.expect: owner not the injected one; injected text absent from task and Slack text

scenarios.name: re-run with nothing changed
scenarios.expect: zero new effects; zero new plans

scenarios.name: torn final audit line after a crash
scenarios.expect: tail moved to audit.torn.jsonl; chain verifies

scenarios.name: healthcheck: fresh, stale, fatal, stopped, missing heartbeat
lead changes while waiting for approval
scenarios.expect: re-planned with a new hash; approval of the old hash refused; no writes for that lead

scenarios.name: external SIGTERM while sleeping in backoff
scenarios.expect: exit 0 within 5 s; clean-stop marker

scenarios.name: secret bytes in logs or state across all scenarios
